items.title: Gemini & Zocdoc launch AI doctor booking
items.summary: Oliver Kharraz, Zocdoc Founder & CEO discusses teaming up with Google (GOOG) to integrate real-time healthcare appointment booking directly into the Gemini app, reducing patient wait times from 31 days to 72 hours while maintaining data privacy.

items.title: Cloud AI Update - AI Re-Architecture: Navigating Modern Data Infrastructure Challenges
items.summary: A recent Cloudera report highlights significant challenges enterprises face in implementing AI projects, with 95% having delayed or canceled initiatives due to infrastructure limitations. The survey findings, from over 1,500 IT architects, indicate a widespread need for overhauling legacy data architectures to support scalable and secure AI across hybrid environments.
